findings.title: A single life carries the gathered human field
findings.claim: The focus treats one life as a representative point of the gathered human whole, so killing or saving that life scales to everyone without becoming a claim of numerical identity.
findings.mechanism: The repeated focus comparison joins the individual self, life as protective good, and gathered totality; 2:85 supplies a wider scene of killing one's own people and divided compliance, while 2:179 supplies a life-preserving legal measure that returns to the same comparison.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the single life as a non-substitutable contact point through which the integrity of the whole human field is either severed or preserved.
findings.containment: This is a bounded social-scalar reading of the focus comparison. It does not assert arithmetic identity, erase the focus's stated legal exceptions, or use the target ayahs as direct glosses of the focus.

epistemic.reason: The originating cross-run finding is trusted and strongly anchored to three accepted or qualified focus branches; the wider contacts are used only as explicit contextual triggers.

findings.title: A branch echo between wasted blood and wasted work
findings.claim: The focus's universal treatment of a slain life meets a branch echo in 5:53 where works are rendered void: the shared relation is the danger of making a claim on life or action disappear.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies literal killing and the living self associated with flowing blood, while the exact 5:53 anchor and attributed trace supply a distant branch image of blood being wasted alongside nullified works.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive a common danger of nullification across embodied life and intended action without confusing the two surface topics.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory, surprising branch echo. The packet explicitly limits it to a nullification analogy anchored by the focus and 5:53; it is not a claim that 5:53 directly discusses homicide or that the distant branch is the focus's ordinary lexical meaning.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 5:53 anchors and the HFT trace are supplied, but the context branches are unresolved and the source itself marks the outlier exploratory.
